text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day before Ikuno Dictus's debut race—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, I think it's about time I get 
going.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, my— Is it already that time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Please take care on your way to Kokura 
Racecourse. I pray for your good fortune.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...I will give it my 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"It is Ikuno-san, who has prepared down to 
the finest detail for today. She will 
undoubtedly be able to give it her all."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...You're too kind.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I'll pick up some souvenirs from Kokura. 
Let's definitely enjoy them together when 
I get back."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My! What a wonderful suggestion...! I 
shall prepare some tea and await your 
return.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the day of the debut race—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: âAnd last. Horseshoes are in good shape.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Full checklist completed. Everything is 
fully prepared and ready.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If I had to sum it up in a single word—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You're nervous, aren't you?
choice_data_list: Wait, is that how it is!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...? Is it strange?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had often seen Ikuno Dictus using a 
checklist for final inspections before 
mock races and training sessions at the 
academy.
choice_data_list: いや、いつもどおりチェックしてたから……
choice_data_list_en: No, I was just doing my usual check...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was going through my checks smoothly as 
usual, so I was a bit surprised when they 
told me I looked 'nervous'..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see. So that's how it was.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It was an attempt to keep calm by 
consciously acknowledging the nervousness, 
and to stabilize performance by following 
the usual routine, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If I looked like my usual self to you, 
Trainer, then it seems my attempt was a 
success.
choice_data_list:
That's some impressive stress management, 
huh.

That's some impressive stress management, 
isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I am honored.
choice_data_list: 見事なストレスマネジメントだな
見事なストレスマネジメントだね

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I can send Ikuno Dictus off 
with zero worries...!
choice_data_list:
First off, let's just go out and enjoy 
your debut race!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Have fun...――
choice_data_list: デビュー戦、まずは楽しんでいこう！
choice_data_list_en: It's your debut race, so let's start by having fun!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. That's certainly true. Well then—
choice_data_list: これも、一生に一度のレースだからね
choice_data_list_en: After all, this is a once-in-a-lifetime race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'll have fun and give it everything I've 
got.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: And...... I will return safely.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm heading out.
choice_data_list: ああ、行ってらっしゃい！
うん、行ってらっしゃい！
